outline.text: The requirements of the relevant anti money laundering legislation require institutions to gather client's information
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: of their professional or business activity. The client subscribes to this Declaration and assumes the responsibility
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: of the provided data listed on this declaration. Additionally, the client commits itself to communicate La Banque
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: des Entreprises (La Banque des Entreprises) any data amendment during its relationship with La Banque des
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: Entreprises. The lack of veracity or updates in the mentioned data and/or documents authorizes La Banque des
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: Entreprises to terminate any or all the contracts formalized with the client.
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: Without prejudice to the provisions of article L.511-33 of the French Code monétaire et financier, and in
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: accordance with them, the client expressly agrees that in addition to the cases provided for in this article,
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: we may disclose to any entities belonging to the same group as La Banque des Entreprises, information
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: about it protected by professional secrecy, if the persons to whom this information is disclosed are
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: informed that it must be kept confidential to the extent legally permitted, or are legally or professionally
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: bound by professional secrecy, and if this information is necessary for them for the following purposes and
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: in the following cases: business development, development and management of the services and products
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: offered, business relationships management with the client and with companies belonging to the same
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: group if any, revenues and financial and operational risks management, fulfillment of their obligations or for
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: auditing purposes or with respect to regulatory or supervisory authorities, and fraud prevention.
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: Communications made on this basis and treatment by their recipient of such disclosed information must
outline.section: Step 4: Details of Authorized Representatives > Step 4: Certification

outline.text: comply with applicable personal data protection regulation.
